admission.justification: Realized across serving/paseo/provider_limit_suppressions.py and serving/paseo/provider_limits.py, proven by three unit tests in mcp/tests/test_provider_limit_suppression.py, and required so suppression releases seats cleanly without masking other real limits.

applicability: Every projection of exhausted account-wide usage windows onto provider-limits.json during usage reads, periodic updates, and suppression mutations.
conditions: Exhausted windows are filtered against live suppressions keyed on exact (report_id, window_id, resetsAt) tuples through project_reports_with_suppressions.
When a multi-window report retains at least one unsuppressed exhausted window, report.until is recomputed to max(remaining.resetsAt) and the remaining window keeps holding seats.

When no unsuppressed exhausted window remains, the report is dropped and clearedSeats is recomputed via _updated_clear_markers under provider-limits.lock so held messages drain and periodic polling stops.
exclusions: A suppression for one resetsAt does not suppress a future window of the same reportId and windowId with a different resetsAt.
Suppression never creates a new limit report or extends an existing resetsAt deadline.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_provider_limit_suppression.py (multi-window until recomputation, single-window clearedSeats/polling-stop, and periodic drop clearedSeats cases) on clean tree 54a3d3198b5f47b34a4987cbadf2c9ca58a20a4d

statement: Every limit write filters exhausted windows against live suppressions keyed on (report_id, window_id, resetsAt) through one shared projection helper, recomputing report.until to max(remaining.resetsAt) on multi-window reports and dropping the report with clearedSeats updated under the same lock when no unsuppressed exhausted windows remain.
title: Shared projection recomputes until or drops report with clear markers
